goal: Generate a white-background product image directly usable as the main graphic on e-commerce platforms, with the product as the absolute visual focus.

subject.visual_description: The white frosted polycarbonate charging case is rectangular with rounded corners, the lid slightly misaligned to reveal the internal cavity; two in-ear headphones with short stems are laid flat in front of the case, with silicone ear tips in light grey-white, the stems featuring a discreet black mesh cover, and the bottom of the case has a USB-C charging port
subject.angle: Front slightly tilted left at a 3/4 overhead view, charging case opened about 35°, headphones symmetrically placed one left and one right.

background.shadow: Soft contact shadows, edges feathered, no hard edges.

lighting.key_light: High position soft light box angled slightly upwards, highlighting the curve of the box lid
lighting.fill_light: One soft light on each side, ensuring that the white plastic does not appear dead white and has no cracking highlights

style.rendering: High resolution commercial photography + clean post-processing, with no scene elements
style.consistency: Colors restore authenticity, texture restores authenticity

must_keep: Product as the sole visual focus
Label text must be clear and readable.
avoid: Color patches appear in the background
Strong Reflection Interferes with the Product Itself
